passed_checks.check_name: Ensure AWS IAM policy does not allow assume role permission across all services
code_block:
EC2InstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref RoleName
      Description: Role allowing EC2 instances to write CloudWatch Logs and read SSM Parameter Store
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Path: /
      MaxSessionDuration: 3600
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: ManagedBy
          Value: CloudFormation
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: EC2-Logs-Config-Access

    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${RoleName}-cloudwatch-logs'

      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreateLogGroupsAndStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*'
          - Sid: PutLogEvents
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupPrefix}*:log-stream:*'

code_block:
ParameterStorePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${RoleName}-parameter-store'
      Description: Allows reading configuration from SSM Parameter Store
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2InstanceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePrefix}/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${ParameterStorePrefix}'
          - Sid: DescribeParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeParameters
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: DecryptSecureStringParameters
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'ssm.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
